exposure: Duration of latent phase of labor
outcome: Adverse perinatal outcomes (seizures, sepsis, bone or nerve injury, encephalopathy, or death)
cohort: 10,677 nulliparous women with term singleton gestations in the cephalic presentation who underwent labor induction at 25 US hospitals
finding: Longer duration of the latent phase of labor was associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery, postpartum hemorrhage, and chorioamnionitis, but not with an increased risk of adverse perinatal outcomes.
